Before joining Research Now as CEO in 2016, Gary was Global Chief Data Officer of Wunderman and CEO of KBM Group, where he grew revenue 10x and operating profit 15x, on its way to becoming a global marketing services industry leader.

Prior to Trax, Regi served as the CFO of Metromile, Inc, a publicly traded auto insurance technology company. He was responsible for Metromile’s financial management, investor relations and corporate development. Regi helped lead the process to sell Metromile which resulted in its eventual acquisition by Lemonade, another publicly traded insurance technology company.

Karan Khanna is the Chief Technology Officer at Trax, responsible for leading global technology initiatives, overseeing product development, and driving innovation across the company’s engineering teams. With over two decades of experience in the tech industry, Karan has a proven track record of delivering top-tier software solutions and spearheading large-scale engineering projects.

Before joining Trax, Karan served as the Chief Technology Officer at Mediaocean, where he led a 400+ person engineering team across multiple continents. During his tenure, he played a pivotal role in integrating AI-driven solutions and transforming Mediaocean’s technology stack, leading to significant increases in productivity and agility.

Prior to Mediaocean, Karan co-founded 4C Insights and served as its Chief Technology Officer, where he grew the engineering team and developed a cloud-native ad tech platform used by major media agencies and brands. The platform contributed to the company’s impressive revenue growth, and 4C Insights was eventually acquired by Vista Equity Partners.

Karan has also held senior leadership roles at Salesforce, Amazon, and Microsoft, where he led various product and technology teams. At Amazon, he was part of the core team responsible for the exponential growth of the Kindle content business, and at Microsoft, he contributed to the development of key products like Microsoft Office, Works and CRM.

David Gottlieb is the Chief Revenue Officer at Trax. David is tasked with ensuring Trax achieves its overall sales and revenue goals, and he works with teams around the world to prioritize markets and solutions that will drive business expansion.

Prior to joining Trax, Kendra held various customer experience and leadership roles at Gusto, where she led teams of over 1,000 employees and drove technology enhancements and process improvements to increase customer satisfaction and operational efficiency at scale. Before her time at Gusto, Kendra served as the Senior Vice President of Global Operations at Western Union.

In this role, she managed a global team of over 5,000 professionals, implementing innovative technologies and lean/six sigma methodologies to improve customer sentiment, retention, quality, and operational efficiency, as well as the employee experience. Kendra holds a Bachelor of Arts in Public Accounting and Music from Illinois Wesleyan University, graduating with honors.

Recently, Marcus was the SVP of Transformation at Western Union where he led lean and agile centers of excellence to ensure efficient delivery of operational process improvements, customer experience and retention initiatives, and digital transformation, as well as leading change management, communications, and leadership development programs.
More recently, Marcus has provided outside legal support for private equity mergers and acquisitions and has consulted on agile transformations for global companies.
Paulina Kadman is the Chief of Staff at Trax. Paulina is working with cross-functional operational and strategic projects.

Prior to joining Trax, Paulina enjoyed a unique career being a serial entrepreneur in various fields across gastronomy, culture and fashion, combining her longstanding interest in emerging technologies. Paulina holds B.A. from Tel Aviv University.
